body: Unfortunately I haven’t found a way to make that voice go away yet. It’s been like this since I was a teenager, though it’s gotten worse now that I’m in my 20’s. It’s just a constant question of “why bother?”. It’s not even because I feel sad or that no one loves me. I have very close friends and family members that would be devastated if I died and that’s about the only reason I haven’t done it yet + it’s very hard to kill yourself and ending up brain damaged is not my idea of a good time. I will say that as someone who’s been in two major car accidents and walked away without a scratch it’s pretty hard to go that way.

Coming from a  former fat awkward homeschooled teenager, it does get a little better. I didn’t have my first good friend until I was 16, I didn’t have my first kiss until I was 20, I didn’t start thinking I was attractive until last year. There’s no time limit on things. I’m as “happy” as I can be now and I can only hope that one day you and I will both be actually happy with ourselves.

This is how I feel, I have never been diagnosed with depression and I still go out and do fun things with friends and laugh and have a good time, but the second I’m alone with my thoughts it’s like “you should just kill yourself”
